description: Make an issue of a message in one of the company's chats — or of a thread of them — in one step, as the screen's «Make an issue» does (PM-1237). The description quotes the messages (who wrote each and when) unless you give your own, and always ends with a link back to the message, which opens only for the chat's people; the messages' files are copied onto the issue; the message shows «→ KEY» to whoever may open the issue. Filed as create_issue files — your rights in that project, its rules, its watchers. A project's chat files into its project when projectKey is omitted; any other chat needs projectKey. Answers like create_issue, with 'files' copied.

alsoMessageIds.description: Other messages of the same chat to quote with it, by id — a thread. At most 50 in all.

chatId.description: The chat's id, as the chat's address /chats/{id} has it.

copyFiles.description: Copy the messages' files onto the issue. Default true.

description.description: Issue description, Markdown. Defaults to the messages quoted; the link back to the chat is added after it either way.

messageId.description: The message's id — the one the issue is made of; its author may be the reporter.

projectKey.description: Project key. Defaults to the project of a project's chat; required for any other chat.

reporterIsAuthor.description: Make the message's author the reporter instead of you — refused when they cannot open the project.

summary.description: Issue summary (title). Defaults to the message's first line.

name: create_issue_from_chat_message
title: Create issue from chat message
